# Add two int32 slices in-place (dst += src).

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func AddInplace(dst, src []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] += src[i]
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func AddInplace(dst, src []int32) {
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, src) {
		for i := range dst {
			dst[i] += src[i]
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = src[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(dst[_i:])
				_v2, _ := simd.LoadInt32sPart(src[_i:])
				_v1.Add(_v2).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, window ...int) bool {
	aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi := 0, len(a), 0, len(b)
	if len(window) == 4 {
		aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi = window[0], window[1], window[2], window[3]
	}
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	aStart, aEnd := aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size, aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
	bStart, bEnd := bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size, bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}
-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/test"
)

func main() {
	dst := []int32{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}
	src := []int32{10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80}
	test.AddInplace(dst, src)
	fmt.Println(dst)
}
-- testmain/output --
[11 22 33 44 55 66 77 88]
-- stderr.want --
loopvec: rewrote 1 loop(s) in $WORK/ops.go
-- ops.go.guarded --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func AddInplace(dst, src []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] += src[i]
	}
}
